set.name: World Events
set.about: Cards for the things that happen to the whole world: weather, time of day, sky and space. Same Card Forge, but a night-blue frame with rays, a burst-edged window and a WORLD EVENT banner, so an event is never mistaken for a tile card. Scenes are painted by the forge in the game's own colours; the meteorite is the game model.

cards.name: Paint Rain
cards.rules: Colourful paint falls. Strange plants sprout where it lands.
cards.flavour: Five colours, five kinds of alien plant. The plants glow at night.

cards.name: Meteorite
cards.rules: A glowing rock lands. Dig it out for a shiny prize.
cards.flavour: Cyan is the meteorite's colour, only ever the meteorite's.

cards.name: Rain Shower
cards.rules: Crops drink up. Puddles pop up for splashing.
cards.flavour: Abbie says rain is just the sky watering the garden.

cards.name: Thunderstorm
cards.rules: Big boom! Animals hurry home. Rain waters every crop.
cards.flavour: Bub hides under the couch. Everyone else watches from the window.

cards.name: Snowfall
cards.rules: Everything turns white. Time for snowballs and cocoa.
cards.flavour: The ranch goes quiet, then very loud with snowballs.

cards.name: Rainbow
cards.rules: Follow it for a surprise. Everyone feels happy.
cards.flavour: It always ends somewhere better than where you started.

cards.name: Golden Dawn
cards.rules: Roosters crow. Animals wake up happy and ready.
cards.flavour: The first light always finds the hens already up.

cards.name: Starry Night
cards.rules: Fireflies glow. Stars come out to play.
cards.flavour: Count them with a friend and you will never run out.

cards.name: Morning Fog
cards.rules: Soft mist hides the hills. Listen for the bells.
cards.flavour: You hear the cows long before you see them.

cards.name: Northern Lights
cards.rules: Ribbons of green dance above. Wishes feel closer.
cards.flavour: Some nights the sky decides to put on a show.

cards.name: Fireball Drop
cards.rules: A cartoon fireball bonks the ground. Warm glow, a scorch mark, nobody hurt.

cards.name: Giant Waterball
cards.rules: A huge wobbly water balloon splashes down. Puddles for everyone.

cards.name: Cats and Dogs
cards.rules: It rains cats and dogs! They land softly, stay, and live their normal lives.
cards.flavour: There is enough food and water for all.

cards.name: Tie-Dye Mode
cards.rules: The whole world, sky and all, swirls in tie-dye colours. A sitar strums.
